Hi @pcbeingused333, thanks for your interest in contributing!

Frappe Framework requires that pull request authors are vouched, and you are not in the [list of vouched users](https://github.com/frappe/frappe/blob/develop/.github/VOUCHED.td).

This PR will be closed automatically. See https://github.com/frappe/frappe/blob/develop/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md for more details.

@iamejaaz this was auto-closed because I'm not on the vouched list. It fixes `if_owner`
not being matched when a Custom DocPerm rule is updated, with a test included. It was
prepared with AI assistance, and I've read the change myself.

Could you vouch for me so I can reopen it, or tell me what you'd need first?
